notes: Recurring reminders and daily tasks now survive restarts and app updates — and reminders can do real work: ask for a daily weather report or news recap and the actual report arrives. The update progress bar finally tracks the download.
notes_zh: 定时提醒和每日任务不再因重启或更新而消失；提醒现在还能“干活”——设置每天早上的天气报告或新闻摘要，到点自动把真正的报告送到你手里。更新进度条也不再卡住了。
